build_multidogo_dataset: build the MultiDoGo dataset by downloading and preprocessing multi-domain goal-oriented dialogue data for all domains
preprocess_multidogo_conversations: preprocess MultiDoGo conversations for a specific domain and datatype with turn or sentence intent labels
build_conversation_span_map: build a conversation ID to line span map from unannotated TSV data for fast lookup
aggregate_and_write_conversations: aggregate annotated and unannotated MultiDoGo conversations into JSON files with intent labels and slots
get_slots_map: extract slot-value pairs from an utterance and its corresponding slot-label string
